401912230.headline: Marist vs. Army prediction: model has Army by 3
paragraphs: Marist visits Army (2-2) at Christl Arena in West Point Tuesday at 6 PM ET on ESPN+.
Our model makes Army a 2.9-point favorite, projecting a 70-67 final, and gives Army a 60% chance to win.
Players to watch: Kevin McCarthy of Army, 13.2 points a game; Dillon Watt of Army, 9.8 points a game; Tate Laczkowski of Army, 7.6 points a game.
